parameters.description:
`msg-to-nextcloudtalk` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Nextcloud Talk destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own Nextcloud Talk destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional Nextcloud Talk destinations bound per enrollment.

This service posts messages into a conversation on your own Nextcloud Talk instance. Open the target conversation in the Nextcloud Talk web interface and copy the conversation token from the end of the browser address bar into NEXTCLOUDTALK_ROOMID.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Nextcloud Talk destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your Nextcloud Talk server
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Nextcloud Talk destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

base_url_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's NEXTCLOUDTALK_BASE_URL value (same format as NEXTCLOUDTALK_BASE_URL)

basic_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's NEXTCLOUDTALK_BASIC value (same format as NEXTCLOUDTALK_BASIC)

roomid_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Nextcloud Talk room ID; used by the gateway-plus transformer channel
